actions.rationale: Batch of 7 features/fixes (F131-F137). Mix of quick UI fixes (F134 sidebar, F137 modal), medium-scope enhancements (F131 catalog UX, F132 queue fix, F135 purchase import, F136 portfolio revision), and one large feature (F133 deck builder). Single dependency chain: F136 depends on F135. All others fully independent. No new external dependencies beyond existing stack (BeautifulSoup already available). Deck builder (F133) is the riskiest — relies on heuristic card selection from catalog data, but scoped to Beta Test section so blast radius is contained.

notes: Gandalf approved via manual gate (didio CLI not available as standalone binary). 7 features planned for maximum parallelism across 4 waves. F133 deck builder is largest scope but contained in Beta Test. F135 purchase import uses existing HTML files in docs/comprasEmLojas/.
